title: Launcher
responsibility: Install and run the shell from one documented command: build the application, start it, own both the application process and the file watcher, and terminate the watcher with the application.
notes: ⚠️ PLANNED, NOT BUILT (2026-08-27). `implementedBy` is absent, and its absence is the only signal in this artifact that says so — the same convention CMP-0011 established, and the same hazard QST-0015 named: creating these records takes the orphan count to zero while nothing exists. 'Every requirement traces to a component' becomes true; 'the shell works' does not. ⚠️ PRODUCTION MODE ONLY (DEC-0018): `next build` then `next start`. `next dev` is a contributor workflow and is not a shipped configuration — AST-0015 showed the two produce different artifacts, so shipping the development server would mean shipping something this project can never validate. ⚠️ THE PROCESS OWNERSHIP IS AN OBLIGATION WITH NO MECHANISM YET, deliberately. The skeleton creates its watcher on `listen` and closes it in its own `close()`, but that belongs to a process owning its own HTTP server; under `next start` there is no such object and nothing has been run. Choosing and validating the binding is this component's design work. ⚠️ PARTIALLY IMPLEMENTED 2026-08-27 BY TSK-0003, and `implementedBy` now points at the scaffold. Read it as exactly what QST-0015's answer says it means — CODE EXISTS — and nothing more. What exists is the Next.js application, a production build, a loopback start script and one route that responds. What does NOT exist is the thing this component is mostly about: a launcher that owns both the application process and the file watcher and terminates the watcher with it. There is no watcher yet to own. ⚠️ BOTH ITS CRITERIA REMAIN `not-evaluated`, deliberately. ACC-0033 (installs and starts from one documented command) is not satisfied by two scripts a reader has to compose themselves, and ACC-0032 (stopping the launcher leaves nothing behind) has nothing to stop. TSK-0013 finishes both. This is the state the planned/built axis was rejected for being unable to express: a populated `implementedBy` beside unevaluated criteria says 'some code, unjudged' precisely, where a boolean would have had to lie in one direction or the other.
